Struct.NormalLayout: Natural alignment; compiler inserts padding; declaration order is preserved.
Struct.PackedLayout: No implicit inter-field padding; arbitrary-width integer fields allowed.

Enum.ImplicitValues: Start at zero; after explicit value, next implicit value increments it.
Enum.ABI: Representation equals explicit backing integer representation.
Enum.NonExhaustive: A non-exhaustive enum accepts backing values not currently named by a member. Match on a non-exhaustive enum requires else. This is intended for versioned external/kernel/protocol values. Ordinary enums remain closed and exhaustively validated.

Union.Untagged: Reading a non-active member as a valid value is undefined behavior.
Union.Packed: All variants overlap exactly in packed storage.

ZinAggregates.MethodCallSugar: value.method(args) desugars to Type.method(receiver,args); pointer receiver may auto-take address only when the receiver is an addressable lvalue.
